name: GWS Toolkit (Phase 1)
description: Security-hardened read-only Google Workspace integration via gws CLI.

enabledServices.label: Enabled Services
enabledServices.help: Read-only Workspace service families available in Phase 1.

binaryPath.label: gws Binary Path
binaryPath.help: Optional explicit path to gws binary. If omitted, PATH lookup is used.

approvedCredentialDirs.label: Approved Credential Dirs
approvedCredentialDirs.help: Credentials file path must remain inside one of these directories.

credentialsFile.label: Credentials File Path
credentialsFile.help: Operator-managed credentials file path reference only.

tokenEnvVar.label: Token Environment Variable
tokenEnvVar.help: Environment variable name for pre-obtained access token.

safeMode.label: Safe Mode
safeMode.help: Phase 1 security baseline; keeps deny-by-default controls active.

defaultScopesProfile.label: Scopes Profile
defaultScopesProfile.help: Use minimal by default; custom scopes are validated as read-only only.

customScopes.label: Custom Scopes
customScopes.help: Optional read-only custom scopes when defaultScopesProfile is custom.
